zh.title: Wizz Air 2027會計年度首季客運成長仍錄約1.98億歐元淨虧損
zh.summary: Wizz Air公布2027會計年度第一季淨虧損約1.98億歐元，座位運能年增25%，可用座位公里成長15%，主因票價下降、燃料成本上升及機隊持續受干擾。執行長Váradi表示燃料價格短期內難以回落，將維持機隊計畫並持續追求冬季成長機會。
body: Wizz Air公布2027會計年度第一季財報，快速擴張帶動強勁客運成長，但票價下降、燃料成本上升及機隊持續受干擾，使該航空公司錄得淨虧損。該超低成本航空公司在該季座位運能年增25%，可用座位公里上升15%，並將ASK成長放緩歸因於從較長的中東航線轉向歐洲境內較短航線。
該公司報告該期淨虧損約1.98億歐元。管理層表示需求維持強勁，儘管運能大幅增加，載客率仍維持持平。Freetrade分析師Alex Pugh指出，廉價航班需求仍在，客運成長強勁且飛機維持滿載，但Wizz Air「載運更多乘客但每座位收入減少」。
中東衝突在該季增加了燃料成本與營運干擾。Wizz Air執行長József Váradi表示，該公司不假設地緣政治條件或燃料價格會快速改善，並稱其基線預期為燃料價格維持高檔，因其他假設均屬推測性。
儘管面臨壓力，Wizz Air計畫營運其預定機隊計畫並持續追求冬季成長機會。Váradi指出該公司擁有23億歐元流動資金部位，相當於近40%的流動性覆蓋率，並稱此水準可能是歐洲甚至全球航空公司中最佳或至少名列前茅。
Wizz Air預期第二季可用座位公里將上升約20%，載客率大致持平，RASK略降。商務長Ian Malin表示需求維持韌性，8月已約79%至80%訂位，9月介於40%至50%之間，均領先去年同期。然而票價較上年同期下降中個位數至高個位數百分比。
Wizz Air持續將運能從較長的中東航線重新分配至較短的國內及歐洲境內航線。管理層預期平均航段長度將自下一會計年度起穩定於約1,500公里。此調整旨在透過讓飛機在較短航線上每日執飛更多班次來提升航段生產力。

en.title: Wizz Air reports approximately €198 million net loss for Q1 FY2027 despite strong passenger growth
en.summary: Wizz Air reported a net loss of approximately €198 million for the first quarter of its 2027 financial year, as lower fares, higher fuel costs and continued fleet disruption offset rapid expansion. Seat capacity rose 25% year-on-year and ASKs increased 15%, with load factors staying flat. CEO József Váradi said the airline does not assume fuel prices will improve quickly and plans to maintain its fleet programme while pursuing winter growth opportunities.
body: Wizz Air reported its first-quarter 2027 financial year results, with rapid expansion delivering strong passenger growth but lower fares, higher fuel costs and continued fleet disruption pushing the airline to a net loss. The ultra-low-cost carrier increased seat capacity by 25% year-on-year during the quarter, while available seat kilometres rose by 15%. The airline attributed the slower growth in ASKs to a shift from longer Middle Eastern services towards shorter routes within Europe.

The airline reported a net loss of approximately €198 million for the period. Management said demand remained strong, with load factors staying flat despite the sharp rise in capacity. Freetrade analyst Alex Pugh noted that demand for cheap flights was still there and passenger growth was strong, but said Wizz Air was "carrying more passengers but earning less per seat flown."

The conflict in the Middle East increased both fuel costs and operational disruption during the quarter. Wizz Air chief executive József Váradi said the airline did not assume that geopolitical conditions or fuel prices would improve quickly, stating that its baseline expectation was for fuel to stay high because anything else was speculative.

Despite that pressure, Wizz Air plans to operate its intended fleet programme and continue pursuing growth opportunities during the winter. Váradi pointed to the airline's €2.3 billion liquidity position, equivalent to close to 40% liquidity cover, which he said was probably the best of any airlines in Europe and even globally, or certainly amongst the best.

Wizz Air expects available seat kilometres to rise by around 20% during the second quarter, with load factors broadly flat and RASK slightly lower. Chief commercial officer Ian Malin said the airline was continuing to see resilient demand, with August roughly 79% to 80% booked and September between 40% and 50% booked, both trending ahead of last year. However, fares were trending between the mid-single digits and high-single digits below the previous year.

Wizz Air has been reallocating capacity from longer Middle Eastern services towards shorter domestic and intra-European routes. Management expects its average sector length to stabilise at around 1,500 kilometres from the next financial year. The shift is intended to increase sector productivity by enabling aircraft to operate more flights each day on shorter routes.
